findings.title: Missing `key` prop on GrafanaRuleListItem in mapped list
findings.body: The old `GrafanaRuleLoader` received `key={key}`. The replacement `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` inside `rules.map(...)` has no key, while the datasource and unknown branches still pass one. React will warn about missing keys and fall back to index-based reconciliation. As new pages are appended via infinite scroll, item state (open dropdowns, delete modals, silence drawers) can end up attached to the wrong rule. Pass `key={key}`.

findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items can never appear in the list view
findings.body: The list view now passes only `promRule`, so `rulerRule` is undefined. The Delete item requires `canDelete && rulerRule`, and Pause (line 123) requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. The new prom-based abilities (`grafanaDeleteAbility`, `grafanaPauseAbility`) are computed but can never render these items. Users with full permissions lose the ability to delete or pause rules from the new list. The updated test only expects 4 menu items, which hides this regression. Both items, `MenuItemPauseRule` and `handleDelete`, need a code path that works from a prom rule or UID.

findings.title: Silence menu item is a no-op when only promRule is provided
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` now shows 'Silence notifications' based on the prom-rule ability. Clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer=true`, but the drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the list view `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined, so nothing opens. Users see an action that silently does nothing.

findings.title: Export and Pause no longer supported for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: The ruler-based abilities gated ModifyExport, Pause and Restore on `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which is true for any Grafana rule including recording rules. The prom-based version uses `isAlertingRule` (`prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule`), which is false for recording rules. As a result, Grafana-managed recording rules can no longer be exported, paused, restored or permanently deleted from the list view, even though this is supported. Use `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)` here instead.

findings.title: Federated rule check removed from legacy useAllAlertRuleAbilities
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` previously computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false`. Federated Mimir rule groups shown through CombinedRule-based components (the existing list, RulesTable, rule viewer) are no longer treated as immutable. Update and Delete become available for rules that should not be edited there. Pass the federation info through or keep the check in the CombinedRule wrapper.

findings.title: returnTo parameter dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The previous implementation built the view href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })`, using `createReturnTo()`. The new item omits `returnTo`. Navigating back from the rule detail page no longer restores the user's list filters and position.
